60	func BuildSubjectFromRTB(object metav1.Object) (rbacv1.Subject, error) {
61		var userName, groupPrincipalName, groupName, name, kind, sa, namespace string
62		switch rtb := object.(type) {
63		case *v3.ProjectRoleTemplateBinding:
64			userName = rtb.UserName
65			groupPrincipalName = rtb.GroupPrincipalName
66			groupName = rtb.GroupName

78		}

81			name = userName
82			kind = "User"
83		}

85		if groupPrincipalName != "" {
86			if name != "" {
87				return rbacv1.Subject{}, fmt.Errorf("roletemplatebinding has more than one subject fields set: %v", object.GetName())

156		name := grb.UserName
